queries.query: large language model network configuration generation intent-to-configuration "network configuration" "LLM" "intent to configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate primary work that uses LLMs to translate operator intent or natural language into network device configurations or change plans.
Find studies and systems that combine generation, automated validation, and iterative repair applied to network configs or NetOps tasks.
Survey methods where external tools or verifiers are used to detect/correct LLM outputs (bounded self-correction patterns) in operational tasks.

queries.query: network configuration formal verification Veriflow NetKAT Batfish "reachability" "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Collect the classical and modern formal/network-verification literature to provide ground truth validators and metrics for correctness.

queries.query: benchmarks LLM for networking "NetOps benchmark" "AIOps benchmark" "TSNBench" "6G-Bench"
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmark suites, task banks and prior evaluation sets used for LLMs in NetOps or AIOps to assess comparators and validity issues.

queries.query: failure modes LLMs for system administration "hallucination" "misconfiguration" "misinformation"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on typical LLM failure modes (hallucination, overconfidence, erroneous outputs) especially in systems/ops contexts.

queries.query: agentic workflows for NetOps "LM agent" "toolformer" ReAct "autonomous agent" network operations
queries.rationale: Survey agentic approaches that orchestrate LLMs with tools for multi-step operational workflows and the safety/reliability implications.

queries.query: constrained generation prompting safe config generation "constrained decoding" "constraint propagation" "prompt engineering"
queries.rationale: Find methods to constrain model outputs at generation time (decoding constraints, constrained sampling, templating) to reduce misconfigurations.

queries.query: evaluation methods for LLM-generated code configuration "execution-based evaluation" "simulation" "emulator" "synthetic tasks"
queries.rationale: Locate evaluation methodologies that run or simulate generated configs to measure operational correctness and side effects.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop verification NetOps "operator-in-the-loop" "human oversight" "human-AI collaboration" network operations
queries.rationale: Identify work on combining human oversight with automated LLM proposals for safer operational workflows and metrics for acceptability.

queries.query: network emulation testbeds Mininet GNS3 ns-3 "testbed" "emulator" "evaluation"
queries.rationale: Find practical emulation/simulation platforms used to execute and validate network configurations generated by models.

queries.query: AIOps literature review "LLM for AIOps" "AIOps survey" "automation in network operations"
queries.rationale: Collect survey and review papers that summarize AIOps trends, taxonomy, and challenges relevant to LLM-driven NetOps.

queries.query: benchmark validity criticism "benchmark validity" "dataset shift" "overfitting to benchmarks" LLM evaluation
queries.rationale: Find meta-analyses and critiques about benchmark validity, shortcuts, and how they misrepresent real-world operational robustness.

queries.query: security implications LLM-generated network configurations "vulnerable configurations" "misconfiguration attack surface"
queries.rationale: Identify studies linking misconfigurations (including those introduced by automated agents) to security breaches or increased attack surface.

queries.query: generate-verify-repair architectures in code generation "code generation" "repair loop" "verifier" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Survey analogous work in code generation where generate-verify-repair loops have been applied; translate techniques to NetOps context.

queries.query: operational metrics for NetOps correctness "policy compliance metric" "reachability test" "regression prevention"
queries.rationale: Gather concrete operational metrics and validators used by NetOps teams (reachability, ACL correctness, service continuity) to measure correctness.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed publications (conference/journal) and arXiv preprints with verifiable metadata.
Tool documentation, code repositories, and technical reports that include implementation details or reproducible artifacts.
Empirical studies or system papers that evaluate LLMs/agents on NetOps or closely analogous operational tasks.
Papers proposing or evaluating verifiers, validators, emulators, or formal methods for network configurations.
Surveys, benchmarks, and critiques addressing evaluation validity, distribution shift, or benchmark artifacts.
Security analyses linking misconfigurations or automated changes to operational vulnerability.
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials or promotional blog posts lacking reproducible technical detail (unless they point to a primary repo/paper).
Non-English sources unless primary technical content is available in English.
Opinion pieces without empirical or methodological substance.
Papers that only test generic language understanding unrelated to operational NetOps tasks.
Datasets/benchmarks without accessible provenance or task definitions.
date_rationale: Cover recent rapid developments in LLMs and agentic workflows (approx. 2021–2026) while including earlier foundational network-verification and NetOps works (2005–2021) to capture validators and operational metrics. Prioritize the latest empirical studies and preprints for LLM/AIOps techniques, but retain older verification literature for ground-truth methods.
